sources.title: Pokémon Trading Card Game Rules — Scarlet & Violet—Paldea Evolved edition
sources.verification: The evolution section states that attached cards and damage counters stay with a Pokémon through an evolution, while Special Conditions and other attack effects end.
sources.supportsZh: 用于退化后仍由同一场上对象保留伤害与附着卡、并清除异常状态和持续影响的通用结算边界；规则书该段直接描述进化，本实现不会把它冒充为所有退化卡文。

sources.title: Golurk V — Evolving Skies 70/203
sources.verification: Rewind Beam says to devolve the opponent's Active evolved Pokémon by putting its highest Stage Evolution card into that opponent's hand.
sources.supportsZh: 用于 `devolve` 组件的最高进化牌回到该卡实际拥有者手牌、且只对已进化目标有效的基础数据契约。

sources.title: Devolution Spray — XY—Fates Collide 95/124
sources.verification: The Item text independently uses the same highest-Stage-Evolution-to-hand devolution operation and adds a card-specific evolve-again restriction.
sources.supportsZh: 用于确认该操作可作为可组合的通用 Effect；“本回合不能再进化”等额外文本不由本基础组件假设，须另以审核持续效果数据表达。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, community ruling, Japanese local ruling or Chinese translation is used as international rules authority.
This record does not certify any historical card's complete wording, format legality or all devolution-related replacement effects.
implementationLimits: Supports one currently evolved, public in-play Pokémon target; it removes exactly its highest Evolution card to that card owner's hand.

Damage counters and attached cards remain with the same in-play Pokémon identity. Special Conditions, protection and other continuous effects on that Pokémon clear through the battlefield's existing evolution/devolution checkpoint.

The server rechecks target identity, current evolution state and effect protection. A Basic target, a protected target, malformed parameters or an unaudited multi-target distribution never silently resolves.

The reusable prevent_evolution component can express the Devolution Spray-style same-turn evolution restriction after this operation, but no real card receives that binding without its own audited text and timing data.
Multi-target devolution distributions, replacement effects and full last-known-information interactions remain unsupported until separately audited.
